name: ruflo-neural-trader
description: Neural trading via npx neural-trader — self-learning strategies, Rust/NAPI backtesting, 112+ MCP tools, swarm coordination, and portfolio optimization. As a mod (ADR-445): a tighten-only guard on its tools, /trader-mod, and a status file the console shows

guard.title: Guard
guard.description: Refuse calls and memory writes that hold a secret. On by default.

liveGuard.title: Live-order guard
liveGuard.description: Refuse a live order call unless it carries confirm: true (or paper: true). On by default.
